Root-level repo docs sit closest to the `domain:devx` docs/gates row; the directly adjacent ADR-registry-integrity cards #6634, #6592, #6676 all carry `domain:devx`.

Its `check:adr-anchors` widening puts `0001` on a shrink-only allowlist that does NOT bless this link — no conflict, no `Blocked-by:`.
- **Note for the implementer**: fixing this must not edit `docs/adr/**` content (ADRs are maintainer-merged only per the 2026-08-08 standing discipline; this card is an `ARCHITECTURE.md` link repair, which stays outside that guardrail).
